shortDescription: CarMax on Tuesday reported its highest quarterly same-store sales growth since fiscal-year 2022. "FTC Crackdown on Misleading Car Ads Buoys CarMax, CEO Says," blog post at 1:08 p.m. ET on Sept. 29 incorrectly said it was the highest since 2022.
